verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón:

Tato ay junok anima smalk'e sniwanil, ma sk'e wochjab', ma chak sulinak tz'aj yilji sniwanil, talaj lepra jun yab'il chi', yowalil tz'ik'jikot t'a winhaj Aarón, ma t'a juntzanhokxo heb' sacerdote yinhtilal winh.

Haxo winh sacerdote chi' tz'ilan jun yab'il chi'. Tato a xi'il b'aj ay jun yab'il chi', sakxo, ma niwan chekel to manhoknhej t'a stz'umal ay jun yab'il chi', palta julxo yich, a jun yab'il chi' lepraxo. Ayik toxo ix ilji jun anima chi' yuj winh sacerdote, a winh tz'alani to maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal yetanima'il.
Tato sakxo yilji stz'umal b'aj ay jun yab'il chi', palta to anhej t'a stz'umal ayochi, manh sakok pax xi'il chi' ta', yowalil smakchaj jun anima chi' yuj winh sacerdote chi' ukeok k'uhal.
Haxo slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', sayjixi iljok jun anima chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' hanheja' max b'eyb'ati, smakchajxi ukeokxo k'uhal.

Ayik slajwi ukexo k'uhal chi', sayjixi iljok jun anima chi' yuj winh sacerdote chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' wanxo sateli, maxtzak b'eyb'at t'a stz'umal jun anima chi', ichato chi' syalan winh sacerdote chi' to manh lepra'ok tz'ik'ani, komon yab'ilnhej. Slajwi chi' sjuk'anel spichul jun pena'ay chi', wach'xo tz'ajxikani.
Palta tato a jun yab'il t'a sniwanil junok anima chi' sb'at lheb'eb'ok, wach'chom toxo ix yal winh sacerdote to manh lepra'ok, yowalil skotxi t'a winh sacerdote chi' yik sayanxi yil winh.
Tato a syilan winh sacerdote chi' to wan sb'at lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi', syal winh to a jun yab'il chi' lepra toni.
Tato ay junok anima ay lepra t'ay, yowalil tz'ik'jikot t'a winh sacerdote.
Ha winh sacerdote chi' tz'ilani tato wan smalk'ei, sakxo yilji sat chi', wanxo pax sakb'i xi'il t'a sat chi', chekelxo sb'ak'chil.

Tato icha chi', haton jun chi' skuchan lepra, kotak skal sch'oxank'e sb'a t'a stz'umal chi', yuj chi' syalan winh sacerdote chi' to maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il. Manhxo yowalilok smakchaj t'a ukeokxo k'uhal.
Tato elanhchamel sb'at lheb'naj jun yab'il chi', smajel sniwanil chi' yuj, hato ha' tz'aj yilanoch winh sacerdote chi',
ayik slajwi yilan winh, tato toxo ix majel sniwanil chi', sakxonhej yilji jun anima chi', syalan winh to manhxalaj smay.
Tato ay junok k'uhal scheklajk'e sb'ak'chil t'a skal jun yab'il chi', maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il.
Haxo winh sacerdote tz'ilan jun yab'il chi', tato ay b'aj tz'el tochnaj stz'umal ichnhej ta', syalan winh to lepra tz'ik'ani, maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il.
Palta tato sakb'ixiel b'aj ix el tochnaj chi', yowalil skot jun anima chi' t'a winh sacerdote,
yik wach' say yil winh. Ha winh sacerdote chi' tz'ilani tato sakxo yilji jun yab'il chi', syalan winh to manhxalaj smay jun yab'il chi'.
Tato ay mach ayk'e junok yab'il mal t'ay, stakjixiemi,
haxo t'a sat chi' smali, sak yilji, ma chak sulinak yilji, a jun chi' yowalil skot t'a yichanh winh sacerdote.

Haxo winh sacerdote chi' tz'ilani, tato manhoknhej t'a stz'umal ayoch jun yab'il chi', tato sakxo xi'il t'a sat jun yab'il chi', a winh tz'alani to lepra jun yab'il chi', yuj chi' maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il.
Tato syil winh sacerdote chi', to max sakb'ilaj xi'il b'aj ay sat chi' to t'a satnhej stz'umal ayochi, wanxo stakji, a jun anima chi' yowalil smakchaj ukeok k'uhal.

Ayik slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', tato yelk'olalnhej sb'at lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi' t'a stz'umal jun anima chi', syalan winh sacerdote chi' to lepra tz'ik'ani, maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il.
Palta tato max b'at lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi', syalelk'ochi to anhej sjech'al aykani, syalan winh sacerdote chi' to manhxalaj smay jun yab'il chi'.

K'inalok ay junok mach ay yaxk'a t'a sniwanil, tato scheklaj sb'ak'chil jun anima b'aj ay yaxk'a chi', haxo t'a sb'ak'chil chi' scheklajpaxk'e junok setanh saksak, ma chak sulinak to sb'at lheb'eb'ok.

Ha winh sacerdote tz'ilani, tato a xi'il wanxo sakb'i, wanxo sb'at yich jun setanh b'aj ay sat chi', tato icha chi', lepra ix cheklajk'e b'aj ay yaxk'a chi', haxo winh sacerdote chi' tz'alani to maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il.
Tato a syilan winh sacerdote to malaj junok xil wan sakb'ieli, to manh wanok sb'at yich jun yab'il chi', palta to wan stakjiemi, yowalil smakchaj jun anima chi' t'a ukeok k'uhal.
Slajwi chi', sayanxi yil winh sacerdote chi', tato toxo ix b'at lheb'eb'ok t'a sniwanil jun anima chi', syalan winh to lepra tz'ik'ani, maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il.
Palta tato a b'aj setkixtak chi', wa'anochi, wanxo sb'oxi, tonhej smal yuj b'aj stz'ai, syalan winh sacerdote chi' to a jun yab'il chi' malaj smay, anhej sjech'al b'aj stz'a chi' skani.
Tato ha t'a junok winak ma t'a junok ix ix sk'e yab'il yaxk'a t'a sjolom, ma t'a yuk'ti',
a winh sacerdote yowalil sayan yil jun chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' wan sb'at yich, mato wan sk'anb'iel xi'il yuj, syalan winh sacerdote chi' to lepra jun ayoch chi' t'a jun anima chi'.
Palta tato max b'atlaj yich jun yab'il chi', manh k'ik'ok wal xi'il b'aj ay yab'il chi', yowalil smakchaj jun anima chi' ukeok k'uhal.
Haxo slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', sayanxi yil winh sacerdote chi', maxtzak b'atlaj lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi', malaj yich, max k'anb'iel-laj xi'il,
syalan winh to sjoxjiel stitak yab'il, palta max joxjiel-laj t'a sat yab'il, smakchaj ukeokxo k'uhal jun anima chi'.

Haxo yik toxo ix ek'b'at ukexo k'uhal chi', sayanxi yil winh sacerdote chi'. Tato max b'at lheb'eb'ok, max b'at yich yuj, syalan winh to malaj smay jun yab'il chi', anhej to sjuk'el spichul jun anima chi', wach' tz'ajxikani.
Palta tato ayik toxo ix alchaji to wach' sk'ol jun anima chi', sb'atxi lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi',
yowalil sayxi yil winh sacerdote chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' wan sb'at lheb'eb'ok t'a stz'umal, manh yowalilok k'an yilji xi'il, lepra tz'ik'ani.
Palta tato wanxo stakji, k'ik' skotxi xi'il, a winh sacerdote chi' tz'alani to wach'xo sk'ol jun anima chi'.
Tato a junok winak ma junok ix ix setkixtak saksak t'a stz'umal,
a winh sacerdote tz'ilan stz'umal chi', tato saktak wal yilji, palta manh kopopioklaj, komon yab'il tz'ik'an jun anima chi' syal chi', malaj smay.
Tato ay junok winak sk'ajb'anel xil sjolom ma anhej t'a snanhal sat sk'ajb'anel xi'il, manhxalaj xi'il skani, a jun chi' malaj smay.

Palta tato sk'e junok yab'il yaxk'a b'aj manhxalaj xi'il chi', yowalil syil winh sacerdote. Tato chak sulinak yilji jun yaxk'a chi' icha yab'il lepra, haton lepra ayoch t'ay. Syalan winh sacerdote chi' to a jun anima chi', maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal yetanima'il yuj jun yab'il chi'.

Ha mach pena'ay yuj lepra, yowalil a pichul nhik'chimtak syak'ochi, malaj smusil sjolom syak'k'ei, smusan nanhalok sat. Tato sb'at t'a skal anima, tz'el yaw, syalan icha tik: Elanhek, chuk waji, chuk waji, xchi.
Ayik ayoch jun yab'il chi' t'ay, yowalil sch'okoj tz'aj t'a spatikel campamento.
Ayik k'ustumtak yilji junok pichul lana, ma lino,
yalnhej tas makanhil, pach'uch'ab'il, ma jalb'il, ma junok tz'u'um to yamk'ab' yaji,

tato ya'ax yilji, ma chakchak yilji juntzanh sk'ustumtakil chi', haton jun makan to tz'el lheb'eb'ok. Ha jun chi' yowalil sch'oxji t'a winh sacerdote yik syilan jun setanh sk'ustumtakil chi' winh, smakchaj jun chi' ukeok k'uhal.

Haxo slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', tz'iljixi. Tato toxo ix b'at lheb'eb'ok t'a jun pichul chi', ma t'a junok tz'um sk'anji chi', a jun chi' haton juntzanh k'ustumtak tz'el lheb'eb'ok, a juntzanh yamk'ab' chi' ay smay.
Yalnhej tas yamk'ab'il to ayxo jun chi' t'ay, yowalil snhusjitz'a smasanil, yujto a jun chi' tzijtum tas syixtejb'ati.
Palta tato ayik syilan winh sacerdote chi' to max b'eylaj juntzanh sk'ustumtakil chi',
syalan winh to sjuk'chajel jun yamk'ab' chi', smakchajkan ukeokxo k'uhal.

Ayik toxo ix juk'chajel jun yamk'ab' chi', ichato chi' syilanxi winh sacerdote chi'. Tato max k'exmaj yilji jun setanh sk'ustumtakil chi', wach'chom max el lheb'eb'ok, yowalil snhusjitz'aok, wach'chom a jun sk'ustumtakil chi' ayoch t'a spatik ma t'a yo'ol, yujto yelxo ay smay jun chi'.
Tato a syilan winh sacerdote chi' ayik toxo ix juk'chajel chi', wanxo satel jun sk'ustumtakil chi', slot'chajel b'aj ayoch chi'.
Palta tato scheklajxik'e sk'ustumtakil jun chi', yowalil snhusjitz'aok.
Ha juntzanh tastak b'aj satel juntzanh k'ustumtak chi' ayik sjuk'chajeli, yowalil sjuk'chajel junelxo, icha chi' syal sk'anchajxi.

Haton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a k'ustum tz'och t'a junok pichul pach'uch'ab'il, ma jalb'il, lana, ma lino, ma junok tz'u'um. Icha chi' tz'aj scheklajkaneli tato wach' yaji, mato manh wach'ok yaji, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi'.
